program.title: BBA in Management
uncertain: total_required_credits (20.0) is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all non-optional groups, using the lower bound for credit ranges (e.g. 3-4).
The three Options (Consulting, Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainability, Human Resources) are optional and excluded from total_required_credits.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 MGMT (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the 2026-27 intake curriculum.

groups.name: Required Course(s)
groups.note: Note: MGMT 4210 OR MGMT 4220 (Consulting Option and CSR & Sustainability Option students must take MGMT 4210)

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: MGMT 3000-level or above Electives: Any 3 courses of the subject and level as specified. Courses taken as Option Required Courses may not be counted towards the elective requirement. The PDF does not list specific courses; courses array is empty.

groups.name: Consulting Option Required Course(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL. Students in the Consulting Option should also take MGMT 3120, MGMT 3140, MGMT 4210 (already in major requirements). 2 additional courses: MGMT 3110 OR MGMT 3160 OR MGMT 4230 (3-4) plus MGMT 4250 (3). Not counted in total_required_credits.

groups.name: Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainability Option Required Course(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL. Students should also take MGMT 4210 (already in major requirements). 2 additional courses: MGMT 3160 and MGMT 3170. Not counted in total_required_credits.

groups.name: Human Resources Option Required Course(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL. Students should also take MGMT 3110 (already in major requirements). 2 courses out of 4: MGMT 4270 OR 4280 OR 4290 OR 4300. Not counted in total_required_credits.
